No other review was consulted; no tracked file, acceptance ledger, original Git state or remote was changed. Previous sealed reviews/evidence remain unchanged.

criteria.criterion: 1. Complete function source coverage including moved dispatch functions; zero generated assembly/raw words
criteria.observed: Both revisions retain exactly 645 functions: 598 C, 36 handwritten_asm, 6 runtime_helper and 5 R011 not_reproducible_c. Non-C entries retain high-confidence evidence and are built from src/asm; all three fragments are source-built. Fresh builds now use 109 C units and 16 68000 assembly units, with zero generated function/fragment units, generated instructions and raw words. All 598 credited C addresses are emitted exactly once per revision, without missing, duplicate or extra functions. Names and catalogue extents are unchanged. Exactly ProcessPresents, OpenSelectedPresent and SetupSelectedPresent moved from src/presents/present_effects.c to src/presents/present_dispatch.c; no other C source-path relocation was found. The three definitions no longer remain in the old file, and the shared external declarations and both-version source registry include the new unit. D1 records the normal pending ledger rebind, not a coverage loss.

criteria.criterion: 2. Fresh pinned byte-identical images and complete named data/source closure under R007/R012
criteria.observed: Two independently fresh full builds of each revision PASS, repeat identically and contain 1048576 bytes. REV 02 SHA-256 is 65ea2386f5f4eda45335d8298ab30bc19d38b9bd5483ffa592818b645c14c163; REV 00 is 2bdfb89bcc8483cf69285c1bca7afa7a41cda59d36da0f068e8f60a923043228. All fresh C/assembly unit lists equal prepare. Each unchanged 4163-unit manifest validates against its catalogue and extract/pack remains byte-exact. All 4120 actual inclusions per retail build are named, unsliced and target their packed or assembled units. The remaining 43 units are C-owned text totaling 2330 bytes, accepted as source-closed by R012; the dispatch split preserves that ownership. The six reviewed unreferenced bytes remain separately accounted and closed under R012. The driver and bootstrap are still assembled from src/z80 under R007. No anonymous baserom inclusion or new source binary escape was found.

criteria.criterion: 4. Same-source REV 00/REV 02 with exactly eight documented revision logic differences
criteria.observed: All 127 registered source entries select both revisions, including the added present_dispatch.c; none was removed. Current source inspection still finds 13 REVISION directives across the same eight function identities/files, with SetupSelectedPresent's three sites now in present_dispatch.c. The pinned ROMs, catalogue/classification/correspondence/data manifests and decoding/mapping tools are unchanged from the complete independent pair comparison. The source registry is the explicit exception, validated separately by fresh builds and the exact relocation check. The prior pair result therefore still applies: 223 byte-identical code entries, 417 address-only changes, eight logic differences and 112 bytes of code growth. Data remains 2519 identical units, 1642 pointer-only units, one header and one uniform fill unit. No new logic or data-content difference is introduced.
